hero.heading:
Software
engineer.
hero.sub_heading: a systems engineer working close to the metal — backends, infra, and the reliability underneath. Shokunin (職人) at heart. Lagos, Nigeria.

about.about_content: I work close to the metal — backends, infrastructure, the parts that keep a system reliable when no one's watching. That's the Shokunin (職人) way: craft for its own sake, not for applause.

roles: AI Engineer — LLM-powered products, RAG pipelines, agentic systems (LangChain, Google ADK)
Backend Engineer — high-performance APIs and microservices (Django, FastAPI, Node.js)
Product Engineer — owning features end to end, from data model to dashboard
Platform Engineer — Frappe / ERPNext customization and integrations
availability: Open to full-time, contract, or consulting — remote or hybrid (Lagos / WAT).

projects.title: Taimako.AI
projects.description: TaimakoAI is an AI-powered customer support platform that leverages an agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) engine. It processes uploaded knowledge base documents to provide accurate, context-aware responses to customer queries via a smart embeddable chat widget or WhatsApp. It features a business dashboard for managing documents and analytics, along with capabilities for human escalation when needed, and subscription billing.
projects.tagline: Context-aware support, without the copy-paste chat-widget feel

projects.title: Blug
projects.description: A blog management system for developers and technical writers — a "bring your own UI" alternative to Hashnode, Medium, and Dev.to, with fine-grained search, tagging, and categories exposed through API keys.
projects.tagline: Your blog's engine, your own UI

projects.title: Auto2GO API
projects.description: Developed a high-performance vehicle reservation system with real-time availability tracking, secure payment processing, and driver management features.
projects.tagline: Real-time availability, without the race conditions

projects.title: Vendkit.IO
projects.description: A smart vending platform that enables businesses, landlords, and property managers to automate and manage prepaid utilities like electricity, water, and gas.
projects.tagline: Prepaid utilities, automated end to end

projects.title: NaijaFarmHand - AI Agent
projects.description: An intelligent assistant built with Google's ADK that provides contextual farming guidance for Nigerian agriculture.
projects.tagline: Farming guidance grounded in local context

writings.title: Gen-Z Slang AI Translator with CopilotKit, ADK and RAG Grounding
writings.description: Build an interactive AI translation tool using CopilotKit, Google's Agent Development Kit, and retrieval-augmented generation to bridge communication between Gen-Z and non-Gen-Z speakers.

writings.title: Simple Rules to Follow When Building Multi-Agent Systems
writings.description: Practical guidelines for designing reliable, maintainable multi-agent AI architectures — covering orchestration patterns, failure handling, and inter-agent communication.

writings.title: Learn Google ADK: Build a farming agent
writings.description: A comprehensive guide to building AI assistants using Google's Agent Development Kit, with step-by-step instructions.

writings.title: Performance Testing: Is Your API Ready?
writings.description: An in-depth exploration of API performance testing methodologies, covering load testing, stress testing, and scalability benchmarking.

writings.title: Understanding Row-level locking
writings.description: A technical deep dive into database concurrency control through row-level locking. Essential for backend developers.

experience.description: Built an AI Agent to support the customer experience team and increase ticket resolution rate by 40%, while optimizing database queries and building internal tooling. These improvements significantly enhanced team efficiency, reduced response times, and accelerated staff productivity.
highlights: Architected and deployed an AI support agent assisting ~110 daily tickets using Gemini and OpenAI models.
Built FastAPI microservices powering AI workflows, knowledge retrieval, and internal automation.
Implemented a Redis caching layer for conversation history, reducing database load and improving response performance.
Containerized AI services with Docker, published images via GHCR, and deployed to cloud VMs / EC2.
Owned and developed the Vendkit platform facilitating vending operations for businesses — dashboard, API, and team management.
Built CRM-style operational tools and optimized Frappe/ERPNext backend queries and data extraction pipelines.

experience.description: Designed an efficient onboarding system that boosted client efficiency by 75%, along with a secure payment flow and smart booking logic that increased reservations by 30%. These improvements significantly enhanced user experience, operational speed, and revenue generation.
highlights: Designed and built an automated workspace onboarding platform, improving client onboarding efficiency by 75%.
Implemented secure and scalable payment processing flows, increasing reliability and customer trust.
Engineered booking engine logic, increasing successful reservations by 30% and reducing processing latency by 20%.
Developed and maintained backend APIs powering production web and mobile applications.

experience.description: Engineered AI agents for marketing and research, built secure RESTful services for fintech applications, and mentored junior developers to boost their efficiency by 60%. These efforts enhanced team productivity, delivered intelligent automation tools, and strengthened core fintech infrastructure.
highlights: Developed AI agents for marketing automation, research assistance, and content generation.
Built a real-time conversational AI chat system enabling interactive AI workflows.
Developed backend infrastructure supporting AI-powered services using Django and PostgreSQL.
Mentored junior developers and introduced backend best practices, improving team productivity.

experience.description: Implemented a secure KYC service for compliant customer onboarding, a high-performance booking system with 42% faster response times, and a robust media upload service for handling large-scale files. These enhancements improved user satisfaction, data security, and overall system reliability.
highlights: Implemented secure KYC onboarding systems, ensuring regulatory compliance and user verification.
Optimized backend booking infrastructure, improving performance by 42%.
Built secure media upload and storage pipelines capable of handling large-scale file uploads.
Developed backend APIs supporting customer-facing platform features.

robotics.title: Machine Vision Robotic Arm
robotics.description: Final-year robotics project combining computer vision and arm control — a custom-trained detector for locating objects, camera calibration, and forward/inverse kinematics driving an Arduino-controlled robotic arm in real time.

robotics.title: Petrol Station Queue Length Optimization
robotics.description: Coursework modeling petrol station wait times — time-series analysis, VAR, and LSTM forecasting to help operators predict congestion, staff peak hours, and cut queue lengths.

robotics.title: ROS2 Robotics Lab
robotics.description: Dockerized ROS2 Humble setup with Gazebo Harmonic and TurtleBot3 — a hands-on workshop environment for running robotics simulations cross-platform with no local ROS install needed.

robotics.title: Basic MATLAB SLAM
robotics.description: SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping) coursework in MATLAB — offline processing with visualization of floor-plan mapping and trajectory optimization.

robotics.title: Robotic Arm Kinematics Simulator
robotics.description: A web-based simulator for visualizing forward and inverse kinematics on a robotic arm model, built to make the underlying math tangible and interactive.

special.title: ffmpeg-video-writer
special.description: A Python wrapper around FFmpeg that builds video files from image sequences.

special.title: speech-diarizer
special.description: A CLI that transcribes audio with speaker diarization — who spoke when, down to word-level timing.
